procedure_notes: MAINTAINER_CUT = line 72 (`<!-- maintainer -->`). FENCE_RANGES = none. Body region = lines 1-71. The line 82 maintainer accept-note explicitly scopes `How we work in this room` to cohort projection before the opening trick-share and removes it from self-study. The agreement was therefore read as a participant-facing cohort contract: its sharing language invites ambient discussion rather than requiring timed public performance, and its trainer reference sets a participant-useful expectation rather than instructing the trainer.
